definitions.gloss: fallen leaves; shedding of leaves; leaf fall
definitions.explanation: The natural process of leaves falling from trees, or the fallen leaves themselves. A more literary or formal term compared to {落|お}ち{葉|ば}.
Used as a modifier to describe trees or forests that shed their leaves seasonally, as opposed to evergreen trees.

examples.english: Leaf fall begins when autumn arrives.

notes:
USAGE:
The same kanji {落葉|おちば} read as おちば is the everyday word for fallen leaves. The reading らくよう is more formal/literary and also serves as a botanical/scientific term (deciduous).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{落葉樹|らくようじゅ}→落葉樹：04961_rakuyouju⟧ (deciduous tree)
- {落葉|らくよう}⟦{広葉樹|こうようじゅ}→広葉樹：04957_kouyouju⟧ (deciduous broad-leaved tree)
- {落葉|らくよう}{樹林|じゅりん} (deciduous forest)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {落葉|らくよう} (らくよう): literary/botanical — formal register, used in science and writing
- ⟦{落|お}ち{葉|ば}→落ち葉：14108_ochiba⟧ (おちば): everyday — the word most people use in daily life for fallen leaves
- {常緑|じょうりょく}: evergreen — the opposite of deciduous
